objects.taxonomy_description: A tall, long-necked ungulate with distinctive ossicones and a spotted coat pattern, distinguishable from other large herbivores by its extreme vertical proportions.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Neck_Length: Possesses an exceptionally elongated neck that is significantly longer than the torso and legs combined.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Head_Appendages: Features two or more short, skin-covered bony protrusions (ossicones) on the top of the head rather than branched antlers or hollow horns.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Body_Proportions: Exhibits a steeply sloping back profile where the shoulders are markedly higher than the rump.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coat_Pattern: Displays a mosaic of irregular, polygonal patches separated by lighter lines, distinct from the stripes of zebras or the uniform coats of horses.

objects.taxonomy_description: An inanimate manufactured object designed for play, distinguished from living organisms by artificial materials and static morphology.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_Composition: Surface exhibits synthetic textures such as molded plastic, stitched fabric, or painted finishes rather than biological skin, fur, or scales.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Structural_Joints: Presence of visible mechanical articulations, seams, screws, or uniform molding lines indicating assembly rather than natural anatomical growth.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Morphological_Symmetry: Features display exaggerated proportions, perfect geometric symmetry, or stylized simplifications that deviate from realistic biological anatomy.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Contextual_Indicators: Object lacks signs of life such as respiration, movement blur, or environmental interaction typical of living creatures, often appearing static and posed.

objects.taxonomy_description: Handheld collapsible canopy mounted on a central shaft with radiating ribs. Canopy is fabric (nylon, polyester) stretched over 6-8 metal or fiberglass ribs. When open, diameter is 90-120 cm. Shaft is metal or wood with a curved or straight handle. Collapsible models fold down to 25-35 cm via a telescoping shaft and folding ribs. Canopy colors range from solid black to vibrant patterns. Tip of each rib has a small protective cap. Opening mechanism is manual (push-up) or automatic (button-activated). Ribs converge at a runner that slides along the shaft.
